notes.title: Death Roads: Tournament is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Death Roads: Tournament is finally out in a full-release version! [/h2]

Get the game on launch discount [b](15% off)[/b] and take part in the most dangerous race this year! 

Thank you, folks, for all your feedback! With it, we’ve been able to rework a lot of balance and difficulty issues. We’ve also added a bunch of new stuff that hopefully will improve your game experience and let you blow up your foes in new, exciting ways.

[previewyoutube=i4ihY4iBvQo;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to drop your feedback and join us on Discord to discuss it - [url=https://discord.gg/acb8Y9tUtK]DISCORD SERVER[/url]

Happy playing!
